Big, simple Christmas pictures for little hands.

21 bold and easy holiday designs with thick outlines and large spaces: perfect first colouring for toddlers and preschoolers.

  • 21 single-sided pages (blank backs, no bleed-through)
  • Snowman, reindeer, gingerbread, stocking, presents, Christmas tree and more
  • Each picture is labelled with a big hollow word to colour too
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages

A great stocking stuffer for ages 2-5.
